worldcombat.skill.firespin.summary: Hurl a spark onto the target and raise a spinning column of fire that travels with it: the column keeps scorching the target and tries to ignite it, and the target cannot outrun its own fire. The only escape is to put it out - become soaked (in water, in rain, hit by a water move) and the fire goes out at once. The blaze style hits harder and faster but lasts less; the ember style burns longer and steadier.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.use.0: Stick to a highly mobile target and keep scorching it
worldcombat.skill.firespin.use.1: Pressure a bulky target with ignited damage over time
worldcombat.skill.firespin.use.2: Force a foe to reposition to put the fire out
worldcombat.skill.firespin.use.3: Drive a target out of water, then light it up
worldcombat.skill.firespin.description.0: The spark deals %1$s special damage and raises a fire column that travels with the target.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.description.1: The column lasts %1$s and licks fire every %2$s; each lick has a %3$s chance to ignite the target, and the burn lasts %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.description.2: Range %1$s blocks, spark speed %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.option.on: Blaze style on: power x1.1, interval x0.8, ignite chance x1.25, cooldown +6, but duration x0.8 - it hits harder and ends sooner.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.option.off: Blaze style off (ember): full power, longer interval, lower ignite chance, but it lasts longer, made to wear a target down.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.growth.0: At level %1$s the scorch power rises to %2$s and the ignite chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.preference.bl: On: scorch power x1.1, shorter interval, higher ignite chance, fatter column, but duration x0.8 and cooldown +6 - it hits harder and ends sooner. Off: burns longer and steadier, made to wear a target down.
worldcombat.skill.firespin.preference.ai: Only consider lighting a threat within this distance; lower it to burn only up close, raise it to start the fire from farther away.
On: do not light a currently soaked target (the column is doused at once, a waste); off: light anyway, useful to drive a target out of the water.
